name: racer-drowned
note: the flooded streets at night: neon, holograms, lightning, wall signs, a shield, a missile from behind (13 s and 6.4 s)

name: racer-drowned-storm
mustFail: sw drowned_calm 0, sw shield_fade 0, sw cam_soft 0: the neon stutters, the holograms flicker, the lightning strikes with three echoes, the wall signs and posters stand a bay apart, a shield bubble goes on and off in a frame and a boost or a missile at the camera lights the road full size, as before (4 flashes in a second at 13.2 s at the right of the view)

name: racer-dam
note: the dam: the corkscrew in the tunnel (31 s) and the flooded tunnel (26.7 s)

name: racer-dam-dash
mustFail: sw tunnel_dash 1: the tunnel lamp strip in dashes 4 m apart as before; where the corkscrew rolls it down beside the view they passed at 9.5 Hz, a regular flicker over the side of the screen (0.137 at 9.5 Hz, 10 flashes in a second at 31 s)

name: racer-dam-splash
mustFail: sw splash_once 0: a splash and a white cloud under a kart in water every time the race tells of it, every 8 ticks, as before; through the flooded tunnel they pulsed under the kart seven and a half times a second (8 flashes in a second at 26.7 s)

name: racer-salt-signs
mustFail: sw sign_gap 0: a corner's chevron boards 10 m apart as before, dark boards passing the kart three and a half times a second against the bright salt (0.068 at 3.5 Hz on GL)

name: racer-orbit-lens
mustFail: sw kart_lens 0: another kart drawn whole however close it comes to the camera, as before: one flying past the chase camera off a jump filled the bottom of the view with its white body and black tyres in turn (4 flashes in a second at frame 2649)

name: racer-orbit-cage
mustFail: sw cage_soft 0: the corkscrew's rings glow as bright as before, and their passing overhead reads as a regular flicker at 3.5 Hz (0.031, the bound 0.02) on GL
